items.title: Momentum and Newton's Second Law of Motion (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Momentum and Newton's Second Law of Motion: a main subheading of 2.7 Momentum, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 38-38.

blocks.text: Mass m ki ek body initial velocity v⃗i se chal rahi hai. Us par external (bahar se) force F⃗ time t tak lagti hai, jis ke baad us ki velocity v⃗f ho jati hai. Is force se paida hone wala acceleration:

blocks.title: Point to Ponder
blocks.text:
Kitab mein do pictures hain:
(a) Paon se patthar ko kick: contact (choona) 1/100 second rehta hai.
(b) Football ko kick: contact 1/10 second rehta hai.
Sochein: kis mein zyada chot lagegi, (a) ya (b), aur kyun?

blocks.text: Newton ke second law se acceleration:
Acceleration ki dono expressions barabar rakhein:
Yahan mv⃗i body ka initial (shuru ka) momentum aur mv⃗f final (aakhri) momentum hai.

Equation (2.26) batati hai ke change in momentum = force × woh time jis tak force lagi. Second law ki yeh form F⃗ = ma⃗ se zyada general (har jagah lagne wali) hai, kyun ke is mein woh case bhi aa jata hai jab body accelerate hote hue apna mass bhi badalti ho. Example: rocket accelerate hote hue mass khota hai, kyun ke us ka fuel jal kar thrust (aage dhakelne wali force) dene ke liye bahar nikalta rehta hai.

blocks.title: Point to Ponder
blocks.text: Kya chalti hui cheez mein impulse hota hai?

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Aap ke baal skull (khopri) par crumple zone (takkar ka asar kam karne wali tah) ka kaam karte hain. Nangi skull (cranium) taqreeban 5 N ki force se toot sakti hai, lekin skin (jild) aur baalon ke saath taqreeban 50 N chahiye.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Patthar wali kick zyada dukhti hai. Change in momentum taqreeban ek jaisa ho to F = (change in momentum)/t; patthar par contact ka time 10 guna kam hai, is liye paon par force taqreeban 10 guna zyada lagti hai. Aur chalti cheez ke paas momentum hota hai, impulse nahi; impulse tab hota hai jab force kuch time tak lag kar momentum badalti hai.
Is liye second law momentum ke zariye yun bhi keh sakte hain:
Kisi body ka time rate of change of momentum (momentum kitni tezi se badal raha hai) lagayi gayi force ke barabar hota hai.
